name: 06c-stitch-tests.json
description: Test videos from an unfinished render package: every unbroken run of 2+ rendered clips becomes test_<first>_<last>_<batch>.mp4 in the package folder with the song cut to that run (Martini Shot Stitch Test Videos). Each clip is the file the app chose: its resolved post-processed version, else the original render. Never overwrites a file; single clips are skipped. Used by Stitch test videos on Results.
